classification.difficultyReason: Identify two pairs of radii, establish triangle congruence by SSS and deduce equality of matching central angles.

content.prompt: $AB$ and $CD$ are chords of a circle with centre $O$. If $AB=CD$, prove that $\angle AOB=\angle COD$.

spec.description: Circle with labelled centre O, four radii and equal chords AB and CD. Matching double ticks are derived from chord midpoints. Ordinary source blue linework and the red centre marker use house black.
spec.mathematics: OA, OB, OC and OD are radii of one circle; AB=CD. No diameter, straight-line or parallel-line givens are introduced.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the source givens are visible; no congruence or angle-equality answer is marked.

answer.short: $\triangle AOB\equiv\triangle COD$ (SSS), so $\angle AOB=\angle COD$ (matching angles of congruent triangles).
answer.worked:
In triangles $AOB$ and $COD$:
$$\begin{aligned}OA&=OC &&\text{(radii)}\\OB&=OD &&\text{(radii)}\\AB&=CD &&\text{(given)}\end{aligned}$$
Therefore $\triangle AOB\equiv\triangle COD$ (SSS).

Hence $\angle AOB=\angle COD$ (matching angles of congruent triangles).
